data.heading: React2u Recover
data.label: Sickness absence support.
data.text: Your regular case manager guides every absence case in line with the Gatekeeper Improvement Act (Wet verbetering poortwachter), the Dutch law that sets the steps and deadlines for employer and employee. You keep control, your employee gets attention.
data.de: The occupational health partner with one regular contact
data.lead: Control of sickness absence starts with attention and direction.
intro: When an employee falls ill, you want to know where you stand. With React2u Recover you have one regular case manager who knows your organisation, talks with your employee and arranges everything for you.
Your case manager works with the company doctor, keeps track of every legal deadline and keeps you informed. That way the support follows the law, and your employee feels heard.
herken: Sickness absence support feels complex and time-consuming
You do not always know which deadline is coming up
You keep dealing with a different person
You are worried about a wage sanction (loonsanctie) from UWV, the Dutch Employee Insurance Agency

groepen.tekst: One case manager who knows your organisation.
Expert, close by and quickly arranged.
items: Task delegation: practice assistant to the company doctor
Open consultation hours, also without absence

groepen.tekst: Every step on time and complete.
The right help at the right time.

stappen.tekst: You report your employee sick, by phone or online.
Within one working day your case manager calls you and your employee.
Together with the company doctor we set out the route to recovery.
We guide the return and evaluate until it is complete.

waarom.tekst: No changing faces. Your case manager knows you and your people.
Follow our approach and you meet the requirements of UWV.
SBCA certified and ISO 9001, 27001 and 27701 through DNV.
